# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`. The ready-pull-request `windows` job is the deliberate exception: it runs Windows Node under Wine on hosted Linux and blocks `all checks passed`; the complete `windows-native` inventory is an explicit manual suite on `windows-latest` and reports independently. Keep pull requests in Draft while iterating and mark them Ready only after local validation; Draft revisions allocate no runner, while every new Ready revision reruns the required merge gate. Do not add `master` CI, self-hosted standby, release, Sandbox, documentation, or real-provider triggers outside the [Saki Actions cost policy](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-08-18-saki-actions-cost-policy.md).
